description: React functional component EntityUsage.tsx for displaying and analyzing usage metrics, costs, and activity data for various entities within a dashboard application.

methods.name: fetchSpendData
methods.description: Fetches usage data based on entity type and date range, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: getTopModels
methods.description: Computes and returns top 5 models by spend.

methods.name: getTopAPIKeys
methods.description: Computes and returns top 5 API keys by spend, including tags and metadata.

methods.name: getAllTags
methods.description: Returns the list of entity tags if available.

methods.name: getEntityLabel
methods.description: Determines display label for an entity based on list, metadata, or fallback.

methods.name: filterDataByTags
methods.description: Filters data based on selected tags.

methods.name: getEntityBreakdown
methods.description: Generates entity-specific usage breakdown sorted by spend.

methods.name: getProcessedEntityBreakdownForChart
methods.description: Prepares topped entity breakdown data for chart display.

methods.name: getFilterLabel
methods.description: Returns label string for filter UI.

methods.name: getFilterPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns placeholder string for filter UI.
